SourceFile
  QualifiedPackage demo.app
  ImportExact Local demo.app.Box as ImportedBox
  ImportExact Local demo.app.make as create
  ImportStar Local demo.app.Tools.*
  struct Box
    field value: Int
  fun make(value: Int): Box
    =
      Call Box
        Var value
  object Tools
    fun answer
  fun main()
    val box: ImportedBox
      Call create
        Call answer
    Call println
      FieldAccess value
        Var box
